- Session: `session_018x7oGZF6qqdUD1Km4e9n5a`, model `claude-opus-5`
- Scope: this epic's charter — objectui repo `bug` cards + objectstack `repo:objectui` cards, workable only when carrying `target:v17`
- Basis: the maintainer's 2026-08-14 rulings quoted verbatim on #8667, and the pointer left on the lane seat post #6025 (2026-08-14T10:58Z) directing whoever takes this theme to register here. Lane seat #6025 stays ⏳ vacant and is not being re-seated by this session.
- Starting posture: the two mandatory pre-work items before any dispatch — (1) re-verify the 8 orphaned `pm:dispatched` cards, #4636 first since the spec-pin GA bump gates every console-side verification; (2) grade the bare-card backlog for the single question "is it a v17 bug?".

De-registration will be posted here on stand-down.

## Pre-work item 1 — orphan re-verification: COMPLETE, and the charter's premise does not survive it

PM session `session_018x7oGZF6qqdUD1Km4e9n5a`. All 8 cards verified against GitHub (claim timestamps, remote branches via `git ls-remote`, PR merge states via the API). **Headline: there are zero orphaned dev agents to reclaim.** Re-dispatching this list as written would have put a second agent into two live worktrees.

The list is three different things wearing one label:

### A. Two are LIVE work, not orphans — do not touch

| card | evidence | age at charter filing |
|---|---|---|
| **objectui#4636** | claim comment 2026-08-14T**10:09:10Z**, session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`; branch `claude/issue-4636-spec-pin-ga` not yet pushed | **49 min before** the epic was filed |
| **objectui#4633** | branch `claude/issue-4633-catalog-regenerate` live on remote; **draft PR objectui#4637** opened 10:57:39Z | **1 min before** the epic was filed |

Also live and not on the charter's list: **draft PR objectui#4638** (`claude/issue-8096-manage-entry`, opened 10:59:31Z, updated 11:00:56Z) against console P0 **#8096**, and **#8500** carries `pm:dispatched` from the same seat.

The lane seat #6025 was seated at 09:56Z and was dispatching continuously until ~11:00Z; the registry correction vacating it landed at 10:58:57Z. The charter swept `pm:dispatched` without reading claim timestamps, so it collected that seat's **in-flight batch** as orphans. Per the dispatch protocol 45 minutes is the *probe* threshold, never the death threshold, and #4636's claim is inside it — the only legitimate action on these is a liveness probe, not reclaim.

### B. Five are ACCEPTed work with `Part of` remainders — bookkeeping debt, not dispatches

Each had its PR reviewed, accepted and **merged**; the card stayed open because the PR was `Part of`, and the protocol's paired write (drop `pm:dispatched` at MERGED, re-grade by what remains) was never made.

| card | delivered | merged | what actually remains |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#4032** | PR #4358 | ✅ | item 4 only — and it is **now unblocked**: objectstack#7862 closed, **PR #8056 merged 2026-08-12** added the `subCaption` key the ruling required. Reaching it needs the GA spec pin, i.e. #4636. |
| **#4280** | PR #4318 | ✅ | ConsoleLayout sidebar rider — explicitly reserved to the maintainer |
| **#4163** | PR #4208 | ✅ 2026-08-11T05:13Z | Part 2 (Studio authoring for inline locale maps) — triage already ruled this `needs-user-decision` on 2026-08-10 |
| **#4109** | PR #4279 | ✅ 2026-08-11T11:01Z | **nothing** — Q1 was ruled A and accepted as delivered; the resolver-export half was split to #4280 |
| **#4036** | PR #4341 (B half) | ✅ 2026-08-11T17:57Z | A half — per-type product judgment on the 15 overlay-allowed types, routed to the spec/engine lane |

### C. One is a genuine stale dispatch — and it is decision-blocked, not dev-blocked

**objectui#3670** — `pm:dispatched` since 2026-08-08, no branch, no PR, untouched for 6 days. But it does not want a dev: the card asks which object the Permissions count should target (`sys_capability` vs `sys_permission_set` — the same ambiguity #3655 left open) and, above that, whether `SystemHubPage` — which carries its own `@deprecated` marker — should be repaired at all rather than retired. Dispatching it as a rename would be answering a product question by writing code.

### Actions taken now

Labels corrected to match reality (each card gets its own evidence comment):

- #4032 → `pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#4636`
- #4163, #4280, #4036 → `needs-user-decision` **restored** (each was already in that state before dispatch overwrote it — no new inbox items)
- #4109 → closed as completed
- #3670 → `needs-user-decision` (the one genuinely new escalation; card face in its own comment)
- #4636, #4633 → **left exactly as they are**

### Consequence for this round: no new dispatch

Inherited in-flight work is **#4636, #4633, #8096, #8500** — already at or past the charter's WIP ≤3 cap, and none of it dispatched by this session. Opening new dev work on top would breach the cap and risk colliding with worktrees I did not create. This round therefore delivers pre-work only. The one decision that unblocks the most is #4636: the GA pin gates every console-side verification *and* #4032's last item.

## Pre-work item 2 — grading: COMPLETE. The named backlog had largely been worked already.

PM session `session_018x7oGZF6qqdUD1Km4e9n5a`. The charter inherited "7 ungraded cards" from the triage seat's 2026-08-13T05:54Z memo on #6025. Re-checked each against current state — five had moved since that memo was written:

| card | state now | action |
|---|---|---|
| #4479 | **closed** (delivered via PR #4562; follow-up #4564 also closed 2026-08-13) | none — carries a stale `pm:dispatched`, harmless on a closed card |
| #4527 | **closed** | none |
| #4533 | **closed** | none |
| #4520 | **closed** | none |
| #4508 | already graded → `needs-user-decision` (chart null-category identity collisions) | none — it is in your inbox, awaiting one sentence |
| #4487 | already graded → `pm:queue` | none |
| **#4526** | `finding`, genuinely ungraded | **graded → frozen** |

Plus one bare card filed after that memo: **#4631** (three disagreeing declared surfaces per component type) — **graded → frozen**.

Both freezes are "not a v17 bug" under the charter's binary test, each with a named restart condition and triggering-file list on the card:

- **#4526** — the disclosed, fail-safe residue of PR #4525: on a single kernel the console renders read-only where the server would accept. An honest lock, not a Save that 403s. Cannot be fixed without reopening the #4518 ruling that forbade the `/discovery` probe.
- **#4631** — a contract-coherence design question, which this regime is deliberately not clearing. Noted on the card: the `tooltip` specimen inside it *is* a live authoring defect (`TooltipSchema` declares `children`, the renderer reads `trigger`; following the published interface renders blank and type-checks). The catalog half was fixed by PR #4630; the type still teaches the wrong key. If a real author hits it, that is a narrow bug card, not this one unfrozen.

**Correction to the charter's inventory:** the grading debt was not 7 cards, and it is not zero either. What actually remains is a large **`finding` pool** in objectui — roughly two dozen open `finding` cards, most filed 2026-08-10 through 08-14 — which the charter does not mention. Under the standing discipline that is a 3–5 card first-touch budget per round, not a batch job. It is not a v17 blocker and I am not expanding scope to it without your say-so.

## Nomination — 2 console cards for `target:v17`, from the hotcrm GA close-out browser sweep

Nomination only: **no labels applied, nothing added to the first-batch list.** Filed from objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1154 (parent hotcrm#1150), which measured five rc-era console findings on `@objectstack/*` 17.0.0 GA in a real browser (Chromium 141, booted app). Two of the five survive on GA and both are console surface.

### Routing note — why these arrive here and not at #8667

The dispatching card told me to nominate survivors on **#8667**. #8667's own Scope section says console-facing cards (`repo:objectui`) belong to this sibling seat, so following the instruction literally would have put console work on the platform desk. Nominating here instead, and flagging it rather than filing silently, as hotcrm#1154 asked. The maintainer's file-at-destination ruling (#7167, 2026-08-10) is the same pointer: objectstack#5084 was migrated to objectui#4024 rather than worked here.

---

### 1. objectstack-ai/objectui#4644 — field designer offers an `Indexed` toggle that hard-blocks the save

Downstream: hotcrm#1122. **Both ends measured on GA.** Console 17.0.0 ships `label:c('designer.field.indexed') … onCommit:e=>D({indexed:e||void 0})`; `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0 `FieldSchema.safeParse` rejects `indexed` by name (`unrecognized_keys`, with a control proving the rejection is caused by that key alone).

Full round trip driven in the browser: tick `Indexed` in Studio → **`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/…` returns HTTP 422 `INVALID_METADATA`** → the draft does not save, the toggle stays ticked, and every later save of that object stays blocked until the user finds and un-ticks it. The error itself is loud and well-worded (a red inline banner carrying the #2377 / #4001 guidance) — #4001's work is holding; the bug is that a control writing a retired key is still offered at all.

**Why v17**: user-facing dead end in Studio with a hard-block outcome, on the surface an admin uses to author metadata. Cheap fix (retire the control). Evidence is a captured 422 body plus screenshots, not inference.

### 2. objectstack-ai/objectui#4645 — i18n residual: detail tabs untranslated in ja-JP / es-ES, two English aria-labels everywhere

Downstream: hotcrm#682. This is the **leftover** after this family's two fixes landed — objectstack#5407 (→ objectui PR #3379) and objectui#4024 (→ PR #4602). I re-measured every string those cards named and they are green on GA (lookup placeholder resolves the label in all four locales; `More actions` → 更多操作; `Sum:` → 合计; the `en` toast joins with ASCII commas, U+3001 absent). What survives:

- built-in record-detail `[role="tab"]` labels — zh-CN 详情/相关/附件 ✅, **ja-JP and es-ES render `Details / Related / Attachments`** ❌. zh-CN being translated proves the slot exists, so this is a bundle **coverage** gap, not an architectural limit.
- `Record highlights` and `Discussion` are the only purely-ASCII aria-labels on a record detail in all three locales.

Attribution re-verified rather than inherited: the downstream page authors only `page:header` and `record:chatter`; the console synthesizer owns the tab strip, and the app's four locale bundles are key-aligned with zero missing keys.

**Why v17**: lower severity than #4644 — cosmetic + a11y. Nominated for completeness; entirely reasonable to defer. If only one of these two is taken, take #4644.

---

Neither card is assigned. Both were duplicate-checked against open and closed objectui cards before filing (searches and nearest hits recorded on the downstream cards). Happy to re-scope either if this seat would rather fold them into an existing card.

Seat A gets one nomination from the same sweep — objectstack#8691, a `packages/spec` contract fix — posted separately on #8667.

**The four console P0s** (#8500 #8282 #8096 #8270) each closed as *completed* on 2026-08-14, so each carries a disposition rather than a lapse.

**The decisive reading:** across BOTH repos the only open `target:v17` card is this one. objectui has zero; objectstack has this epic and nothing else. Its sibling #8667 (Seat A) closed as completed on 2026-08-15 — this card is the survivor of a pair, not an open theme.

**What is deliberately NOT claimed.** 15 `repo:objectui` bugs and 8 `bug`-labelled objectui cards are open today, filed after this charter. None carries `target:v17`, i.e. the triage seat never graded any of them a v17 blocker, and this epic's own workability rule is that only `target:v17` cards are in scope. They are ordinary backlog and stay that way; closing this card does not dispose of them and must not be read as doing so. Two are worth a maintainer's eye before a release on their own merits rather than as blockers — #14912 (`security`, edit affordance derived from object-level `writeScope` only) and #14888 (`page:header` crashes with React #31 on a null name field) — and both are already queued as ordinary cards.

`target:v17` is left on the card as the historical record of what it was scoped to; the release board counts only OPEN cards, so the board is clear as of this close.

Closed on the maintainer's direct instruction in session `session_62849a16-0144-4728-8942-9f60bb3a73f1` — verbatim: 「发版阻塞（target:v17）1 张：#8668 … 你帮我处理」.
